{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tandem Open''', or the '''Open''', was an event in the [[Swoopdueling/Legends|swoopdueling]] championship organized on [[Jervo's World]] above [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]]. Combatants were armed with their choice of weapons and aerial vehicles. The vehicles were most often [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] or [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] but could also include [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] and even flying creatures. There were four semifinal rounds, and the top two finishers in each semi advanced to the final.<ref name="Tandem Final">{{Faraway|url=Home/tabid/58/EntryID/106/Default.aspx|text=Farawaypress.com}}</ref>

[[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Demagol]], posing as [[Rohlan Dyre]], once participated in this event, and "Rohlan" emerged a champion with a ''[[Goethar Special]]'' as a prize.
